subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — Orchard Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — Orchard Health

Hi Emily — great to chat earlier. Thanks for the time and context. Recording the key takeaways and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before the kickoff: 

Summary from discovery
- Primary use: clinical decision-support assistant integrated into Orchard Health provider portal.
- Data types: PHI (patient notes and identifiers), clinician-entered text, and de-identified analytics.
- High-level asks: SOC 2 evidence, encryption at rest/in-transit details, data retention and deletion policy, data residency controls (US-only), and integration network architecture.

Proposed systems in scope (please confirm / add owners):
1) Redwood inference service endpoints (hosted/dedicated options) — core inference runtime
2) Customer integration: App backend (AWS account: orchard-prod), S3 buckets for prompt/asset storage
3) Postgres primary DB (provider-managed)
4) Analytics & event stream (Segment) — we need to confirm whether sample data flows out
5) Logging/observability: CloudWatch & optional GCP Stackdriver for analytics testing

Immediate asks / next steps
- Please review the attached Security Questionnaire (Orchard_Health_Security_Questionnaire_20270705.pdf) and the intake template (Redwood_Security_Intake_Template.xlsx). Fill the intake template where possible and return by EOD Thu, Jul 8 so we can prep answers for the kickoff. [attachment:Orchard_Health_Security_Questionnaire_20270705.pdf] [attachment:Redwood_Security_Intake_Template.xlsx]
- Can you share the technical owner for Segment/analytics and the procurement/legal contacts we should include?
- Proposed kickoff: Mon Jul 12 or Tue Jul 13, 30–45 min with security, legal, and the technical owners. We’ll use that session to confirm scope and timelines.

Who’s on our side
- Marissa Cole — Account Lead (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) — overall PM for the review and timing
- Neha Kapoor — Solutions Engineer (neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com) — will run the technical portion and questionnaire responses
- Sean Gallagher — Security Engineering (sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com) — available for architecture deep-dive

Thanks again — I’ll follow up in two days with a calendar invite for the proposed slots once you confirm availability and contacts.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@orchardhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — Orchard Health

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the templates. A few clarifications and added contacts below.

Scope clarifications / additions
- Confirming PHI in-scope. We will need SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA BA discussions.
- Segment is used for analytics; we have a processing pipeline that strips identifiers for analytics. I will confirm a data flow diagram by EOD Wed.

Owners / procurement/legal contacts
- Technical owner (analytics / Segment): Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@orchardhealth.com> (cc’d on this thread)
- Legal: Karen Li <karen.li@orchardhealth.com> (not yet cc’d) — she’ll handle contracts and privacy review
- Procurement: Rachel O’Neill <rachel.oneill@orchardhealth.com> — will manage PO and procurement timeline

Constraints / requirements
- Data residency: US-only (production) — any cross-region processing must be documented and approved
- Retention: minimum 7 years for clinical logs (state regs) — will need to validate how Redwood surfaces deletion requests

Attached is our internal security requirements doc for context (Orchard_Security_Reqs.pdf). I’ll get the Segment owner to fill the intake template.

Available for kickoff: Mon Jul 12 after 11:00 PDT, Tue Jul 13 all day.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Torres
Sr. Product Manager, Orchard Health
emily.torres@orchardhealth.com
[attachment:Orchard_Security_Reqs.pdf]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@orchardhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — Orchard Health

Thanks Emily — and thanks for routing Karen, Daniel, and Rachel. A few quick notes from the engineering side: 

1) Questionnaire intake
- We’ll start by filling the intake template where possible. For technical questions we don’t have direct visibility into (e.g., vendor-managed Postgres encryption specifics), we’ll list the required evidence and ask for the DB vendor contact or screenshot of settings.

2) Systems ownership ask
- Can Daniel confirm if Segment is used to forward any raw PII off-platform (even to 3rd-party analytics)? If yes, we need to pull the exact flow for the questionnaire and any controls. If no, great — that lowers the risk surface.

3) Technical kickoff
- Recommend a 30-minute technical kickoff between Sean and your engineers to walk integration points (auth, VPC peering, S3 access patterns). Sean, can you take the technical slot on Mon Jul 12 11:30–12:00 PDT or Tue Jul 13 10:00–10:30 PDT?

4) Documentation we’ll prepare before kickoff
- Completed sections of the questionnaire that we can answer
- Short architecture diagram for the inference flow (Redwood-hosted endpoint -> customer backend -> optional S3 storage)
- List of standard controls (encryption, RBAC, logging retention) and any optional add-ons (VPC-only Private deployment)

Action items
- Emily: confirm Daniel’s answer about raw PII forwarding and confirm Karen/Rachel’s availability for the kickoff legal/procurement portion (we typically keep that to 15 min).
- Daniel / Segment owner: if possible, please open the intake template and add any fields you can.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on filling parts of the template until I have Daniel’s note on Segment.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@orchardhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — Orchard Health

Thanks all — quick update and confirmed next steps.

- Emily: appreciate the Orchard_Security_Reqs doc. Per Emily, we’ll treat PHI as fully in-scope and prioritize SOC 2 + HIPAA controls.
- Daniel / Segment: please confirm by EOD Mon Jul 12 whether any raw identifiers flow to Segment; if yes, flag which environments.
- Legal / Procurement: Karen & Rachel, could you share any contracting timeline constraints? Our standard timeline for SOC evidence and contract review is ~3 weeks, but we can surface critical docs earlier if required.

Scheduled items
- Technical kickoff with Sean: Mon Jul 12 at 11:30–12:00 PDT (calendar invite sent). Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orchard-security-kickoff-20270712
- Legal/procurement sync: Tue Jul 13 9:00–9:15 PDT (15 min) — quick intro and timeline agreement.

Attachments: questionnaire + intake template; I’ll upload our short architecture diagram to the Drive link and share before the technical kickoff.

Finally — flags for your legal team: our BA/BAA template and standard data processing addendum are available; happy to share drafts prior to the legal sync to speed review.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa
